root_cause.text: The led-backlight driver omitted creating a device link between the consumer (backlight) and the actual supplier LED device (the LED driver chip), preventing proper removal ordering and causing a NULL pointer dereference when the supplier is removed first.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `device_link_add(&pdev->dev, priv->leds[i]->dev->parent, DL_FLAG_AUTOREMOVE_CONSUMER)` to establish the required link, and the CVE description states that without this link, the LED driver can be removed before the backlight, triggering the crash.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add device link to enforce dependency between backlight device and LED suppliers to ensure proper ordering and prevent removal races.
intent_record.what: Added a loop that creates device links from the backlight platform device (consumer) to the parent of each LED device (supplier) using DL_FLAG_AUTOREMOVE_CONSUMER, with error handling that unregisters the backlight device and returns -EINVAL on failure.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that the backlight driver maintains a proper device dependency on the LED suppliers, preventing the suppliers from being removed or suspended before the consumer, and aborts probe if any link creation fails.
